name: PixelTrail-TS-TW
title: Pixel Cursor Trail
blurb: Pixelated cursor trail that fades and dissipates with configurable grid…
description: React Three Fiber + drei useTrailTexture hook rendering a pixelated trail as the pointer moves. Trail fades based on age and interpolation easing.
use_when: Interactive portfolio showcases, game-inspired UX, or creative interactions where cursor feedback enhances tactile…
avoid_when: Touch-only devices (no pointer), or performance-sensitive mobile contexts — three.js rendering is expensive.
a11y: Interactive pointer effect; no keyboard interaction or focus states. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
